release_rule.horizons: H1/H2/H3 = last day of the 1st/2nd/3rd month of the target quarter (forecast origin O)
release_rule.standard: value of month m usable at O iff end(m) + lag_days <= O
release_rule.conservative: value of month m usable at O iff end(m) + max(lag_days + 15, 3) <= O
release_rule.gdp: training uses the GDP quarters before the target from its training start; production target = quarter after the latest published GDP

training.rule: targets from production_first train on the quarters from train_start; earlier targets (the early track record) on every quarter from early_train_start; inverse-MSE combination weights use errors from production_first (record_first for earlier targets); the Kalman DFM panel starts in the first month of the training window

variables.name: Real GDP growth, year to date (quarterly release)
variables.hub_notes: SIAT 3698 from 2018Q1; 2016Q1-2017Q4 from SIAT 3122 (GDP growth by the expenditure method: the same total, equal to 3698 to the published decimal in every quarter both cover, 2018Q1-2026Q1). SIAT cumulates it from January: Q1 = Jan-Mar, Q2 = Jan-Jun, Q3 = Jan-Sep, Q4 = the whole year (equal to the annual growth rate), each vs the same months of the previous year.

variables.name: World gold price
variables.role: Global gold valuation / terms of trade
variables.native_source: World Bank Pink Sheet: Gold (monthly average, USD/oz)
variables.hub_notes: HUB PROXY. The Pink Sheet is not in the Hub (wb-gem-monthly has no gold price). Used instead: CBU monetary gold in USD / fine troy ounces held (nsdp-ir) = end-of-month market valuation per ounce (2024-12: 2,605 USD/oz); the monthly price is the midpoint of the previous and current month-end valuations, which approximates the Pink Sheet monthly average (2014-2025: correlation of monthly log changes 0.87, RMSE 1.6 pp; end-of-month alone: 0.71, 2.8 pp). Ounces are rounded to 0.01 Moz. Treat gold_price results as approximate; a Pink Sheet connector would remove the proxy.

variables.name: Real broad money (M2 deflated by CPI)
variables.role: Real liquidity / monetary conditions (headline Kalman factor model)
variables.native_source: CBU 4-009-0020 broad money (as m2) minus 12-month headline CPI inflation (SIAT 1285 to 2020-12, SIAT 1286 from 2021-01)
variables.hub_notes: Hub derived series, not in registry v1.2: 100*ln(M2_t/M2_t-12) minus the sum of the last 12 monthly CPI log changes 100*ln(CPI_m/100). CPI is read from January 2019 (REAL_M2_CPI_FROM), so the series starts in December 2019; the start year was chosen in the research run of 6 October 2026 (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021 tested). Lag 25 days (M2; CPI is published after 5).

hub_notes: SIAT monthly tables are stored as published (year-to-date cumulative under 'YYYY-MM' codes); panel.py de-cumulates them to monthly flows before computing growth rates.

gold_price: the World Bank Pink Sheet is not in the Hub; the price implied by CBU monetary gold (USD value / troy ounces, month-end), averaged over the previous and current month-end, is used. It enters only the factor models and the multi-indicator models, not the headline.
russia_ipi: Rosstat is not collected, so this registry variable is not used.
Deposits, credit and payment series come from the CBU statistical bulletin (monthly history since 2020) plus the latest monthly snapshots; the most recent months can have gaps.
USD/RUB: the CBU archive has one rate per week until Feb-2021 and one per business day afterwards. The month in progress is flagged partial and set to NaN.

ytd.rule: y_t = sum_s w_s g_s with w_s = section share in GDP over the same months of the previous year (current prices); Q2-Q4: g_s = previous quarter's published growth + change of the section's monthly SIAT index since the end of that quarter (industry B-E, construction F, trade G = mean of retail and wholesale), else the previous quarter's growth; Q1: mean of the section's last two annual growth rates. Flash stage H4 (quarter end + the longest indicator lag): the same, and Q1 sections with an index also move by the index change since December.
